name: snomed-ct
label: SNOMED CT (Schema)
description: SNOMED Clinical Terms — 350,000+ clinical concepts. Schema only; load data via: flask forge templates install-data snomed-ct (requires NLM UMLS license)
short_description: SNOMED Clinical Terms — 350,000+ clinical concepts. Schema only; load data via: flask forge templates install-data snomed-ct (requires NLM UMLS license)
long_description: SNOMED CT is the world's most comprehensive clinical health terminology with 350,000+ clinical concepts organized in a poly-hierarchy. The schema includes the RF2 release format tables: concepts, descriptions (preferred terms, synonyms), relationships (is-a, finding site, etc.), and transitive closure for subsumption queries. Requires UMLS license for US use; other countries may have free access via SNOMED International.
when_to_use: Use for clinical decision support, problem list encoding, allergy recording, and clinical documentation requiring standard clinical terms. Required by UK NHS, mandated in many EU countries, and recommended by US ONC. Pair with FHIR R4 for complete clinical interoperability. Load data via: flask forge templates install-data snomed-ct
